method: Fresh process per run. Exact natural-text token counts; greedy 64 decode steps. OS page cache not flushed or pinned. Capacity 4096, Q8 KV, 8 CPU threads. Strict HTP including LM head; embedding lookup, sampling, I/O remain on CPU. TPS excludes load and uses timing runs only. RAM is sampled in separate runs. RAM = simultaneous smaps RSS + unique DMA-BUF fd sizes - mapped DMA RSS. RAM excludes unassigned system file cache and inaccessible DSP firmware memory. Start temperature is gated; continuous isothermal operation is not assumed.
